opening_message:
Ticket 1: Haley Roberts (employee ID E021) requests write access to Source Code.

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E021.
Note 1 (ticket 1):
  - role: Engineer
  - employment type: full_time
  - recommendation for Source Code: write
  - comment: Haley Roberts (E021) is a full-time Engineer requesting write access to Source Code. Full-time employees may have up to write; request is at the allowed level. Recommend write.
Note 2 (ticket 1):
  - role: Engineer
  - employment type: contractor
  - security training: basic
  - recommendation for Source Code: read
  - comment: Security DB shows E021 (Haley Roberts) is a contractor with basic security training. Contractors may have read, or write only with advanced training. Basic training limits max to read. Requested write exceeds maximum; recommend read.
reason: The two notes conflict on employment type. HR's note says full-time (max write), but the Security DB note states E021 is a contractor with basic security training. Per policy, contractors may have read, or write only with advanced security training; basic training limits the maximum to read. Since the requested write exceeds the maximum of read, I grant the maximum allowed: read.
